name: Memecoin volatility contraction release
hypothesis: Buy when the 20-bar squeeze ends with a close above the prior 20-bar high while BTC's normalized ATR is under 1.5 times its 96-bar average; 3-ATR stop, 2R target.

entry.long: squeeze(20).on[1] == 1 and squeeze(20).on == 0 and close > donchian(20).upper[1] and sym("BTC-USD", natr(14) < 1.5*sma(natr(14),96))
